{{Quote|Subject identified as Duchess Satine Kryze.|A police probe on Coruscant|<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>}}
'''Duchess''' was a title of [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] held by [[Gender/Legends|females]]. Duchess [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] was a pacifist aristocrat hailing from [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she ruled over the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]].<ref name="TCWTMP">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> [[Marcha]] of [[Mastigophorous]] was the Duchess of her family at the time of the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]].<ref name="AaS">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref> The [[Nyemarian]]s were led by a duchess, who resided in the [[Nyemari Royal Palace]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref>
